purpose: Reproduce sync-related kicks by holding four seconds of TCP traffic after the first movement input, then release it. Each native client exits at its configured 20-second app deadline.

conditions.server: isolated seed 42 GeographyV3 world per run
conditions.traffic: ordinary neutral movement commands; keyboard movement and release are covered by the client TCP regression

server_disconnects: Session 1 disconnected: movement time 0.023085168 exceeded available credit 0.0065670521222694405 at sequence 23

complete_fix_downlink.exit_note: TCP reset at successful scheduled native app shutdown; no server movement rejection. Input sequences continued after the four-second delay.
complete_fix_downlink.capture_note: World loading left only 6.81 seconds before the fixed app deadline, shorter than the eight-second automatic screenshot settling interval.

complete_fix_uplink.exit_note: TCP reset at successful scheduled native app shutdown; no server movement rejection. Input sequences continued after the four-second delay.

limits: Native macOS shared-client evidence, not a physical Android, integrated-GPU, Linux/Windows runtime or published APK check. No production state was modified. Final uplink screenshot shows the recovered joined world.
